strengths: Pure module with zero imports (no React/component/Next) — verifiable without jsdom, satisfying the must-not-have 'file murni' bar.

SORT_ALLOWLISTS mirrors the spec's DIPUTUSKAN allowlist table exactly for all 6 pages (outlets, products, users, promotions, orders, sales-performance) and documents the mirror as the single source of truth.

compareRows enforces nulls-last in BOTH asc and desc (null/undefined/'' short-circuit to +1/-1 before any direction flip) and applies an id DESC tiebreak regardless of direction — verified by reading the comparator, not just test names.
buildCountLabel never fabricates a total when `total` is absent: it emits the estimate form 'Halaman 2 · ada data lain' (or a bare page label), never 'dari' or a fake count.
formatDateTime tolerates null/undefined/''/malformed and returns an em dash, so cells never render 'Invalid Date'; null-safe behavior matches the spec's Rule 7.
toggleSort is the single source of direction logic: same column flips desc→asc→desc, new column starts at desc.
All 4 unit test groups (allowlist, compareRows, paginate/format/label, toggleSort) pass: 16/16.
Refactor heuristics clean: admin-table.ts = 193 lines, test = 184 lines (both < ~300), largest function ~25 lines (< ~50), no logic repeated 3+ times.

issues.description: normalizeSort falls back to the global DEFAULT_SORT_COLUMN 'created_at', which is NOT a member of the sales-performance allowlist ('name','id'). This is per the task spec ('column outside allowlist → created_at') and mirrors backend ListQuery's global default, so it is non-blocking, but the T16 sales-performance integrator must not route 'achievement' through normalizeSort (it sorts client-side) or the server would re-fallback to name ASC.
